tutorial.all_mercs_down.dialog:
Bad news, Boss. We have exhausted all our supplies of consciousness chips and no longer have the ability to clone operators. Our situation is as close as possible to the complete destruction of our company as a structure.

The only solution available to us at the moment... Is to send you on a mission, Boss.
tutorial.armorstation.dialog: This is a list of armor modification projects. Here you can select armor that you have unlocked the chip for and improve its characteristics. Keep in mind that the price of modification grows exponentially, and the number of projects is limited.
tutorial.augmentations.dialog:
This is the augmentation and implant installation screen. You can freely install and remove them here at any time.

Augmentations replace body parts. Keep in mind that organic and cybernetic body parts require different meds to treat wounds. The type of body part a particular medicine treats is indicated in its description.

Implants do not replace body parts. Instead, they are installed into them. They can provide both passive bonuses and active abilities. As a rule, active implants have a limited number of uses per mission. However, you can sometimes find stations during missions that replenish their charges.

Most importantly, wounds, even when bandaged, will disable augmentations and implants in their respective slots. This applies to both passive bonuses and active implant abilities. However, penalties will continue to apply.

The Augmentation Department isn't required to install augmentations and implants. It will, however, allow us to manufacture them ourselves if we have the recipe.
tutorial.bramfatura.dialog:
This is Professor Eipschwitz speaking. Congratulations, Magnum! You've managed to move an entire HIS between realms. I'm transmitting this message to help you get your bearings.

Welcome to the Pleroma, the realm of bramfaturas. Don't panic. Outside, in the Kenoma, time has completely stopped. Everything that happens here takes place beyond the physical world.

The systems of HIS Magnum are locked down. No decoders, no operation accelerators, no access to fabrication modules or gear upgrades. There's nowhere to send a trade shuttle, either. Nothing familiar. Just you, Jane, the crew, and the clones. You're on your own.

Upon entering the Pleroma, the telefaturic engine's energy level is at one hundred percent. It is gradually depleted by travel between bramfaturas and clones' descents into them. Once the reserve runs dry, the engine will simply eject Magnum back into the Kenoma.

Now for the most important part.

Quasimorphs here are always at maximum strength. Actually, this is their normal strength in their natural habitat. The deeper you descend, the greater the pressure of the bramfatura, and the harder it becomes to survive.

Bramfaturas are endless. The natural tunnels inside only lead one way—downward. There are no paths back up through the bramfatura tunnels.

Evacuation is possible at any time. A return portal appears at a random location. Once it is activated, all that is left is to find it and return to Magnum. Don’t be afraid to retreat—sometimes it's the only right call.

And one last thing: Quasimorphic samples are worth the risk. But you have to manage to bring them aboard Magnum.
tutorial.broken_backpack.dialog: Your backpack has torn. That’s a pity. Try to keep an eye on the condition of your equipment yourself, as I won’t always be here. Contents will constantly spill out of a torn backpack or vest. To repair it, use any available fabric.
tutorial.broken_weapon.dialog: Weapons have a tendency to break with regular and active use. To repair them, you can disassemble other unnecessary weaponry or use a repair kit.
tutorial.ecolapse.dialog: The phenomenon in which a creature is torn from the inside and a quasimorph appears in its place is called an <color=#FFFEC1>eccolapse</color>. On the first turn the newly appeared quasimorph is invulnerable—it is phasing between our and their realities. At this moment, it makes no sense to fire at it. It’s better to take a tactically more advantageous position.
tutorial.faction_capture.dialog:
The Proxy Department allows us to conduct a hostile takeover raid against one of the minor corporations. Select the desired target, click "Capture Faction", and we'll track down their CEO. From there, we simply need to eliminate them, and the corporation will be ours. Not on paper, of course.

By capturing the corporation, we will gain unlimited access to our proxy's station inventories, and we will be able to change its active strategy through the faction screen in the Stock Market. In the future, we will even be able to change our proxy type, which will alter its production chains, proxy alliances, and available missions.

Just keep in mind, Boss, that we can't have more than one proxy.
tutorial.first_death.dialog: <color=#FFFEC1>Clones</color> often die on missions. There's nothing to be done about it, but on the other hand, any clone can be reprinted on a <color=#FFFEC1>bioprinter</color>. Plus, we have <color=#FFFEC1>insurance</color> for such cases, which partially compensates for the lost equipment. To do this, find the <color=#FFFEC1>Emergency Case</color> in the Magnum's inventory, right-click on it, and select <color=#FFFEC1>dismantle</color>.
tutorial.gas.dialog: Be careful, there is a gas cloud near you. Gases can block your vision, and they do not all consist of harmless water vapor. Exercise caution when entering a gas cloud. Better yet, simply avoid them.
tutorial.genomeeditor.dialog: This is a list of clone development projects. Here you can choose a clone of an operator that you have unlocked the chip for and improve their characteristics or even change their personal perk. Keep in mind that the price of modification grows exponentially, and the number of projects is limited.
tutorial.item_production.dialog:
The capacity of our mother spacecraft allows us to produce items directly on board. To produce most simple items, we only need a licensed chip.

There are examples in history of how one corporation tried to introduce an additional fee for each item produced, but as a result of a six-day war, the corporation went bankrupt, and all the others rejected this kind of monetization.
tutorial.jammer.dialog: This device is a communication jammer. It jams some of the communication channels between you and the Magnum. Therefore, we cannot send you station minimaps. If you destroy the jammer, the channels will be free and the minimap will be accessible. So don't hesitate, shoot.
tutorial.magnumspaceship.dialog: This is the <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Magnum</color> control screen. From here, you can access the list of clone operators and the cargo hold (top right corner of the screen). To go to the spacecraft's compartments click on any compartment marker.
tutorial.memorydefrag.dialog: This is a list of class development projects. Here you can select a class and replace its perks with the perks of any other unlocked class. Keep in mind that the development price increases exponentially depending on the number of perks being replaced, and the number of projects is limited.
tutorial.mob_throw_grenade.dialog: Enemies can also use grenades. Of course, they do it much worse than our operators, but there are exceptions. To avoid getting hit by shrapnel, it's better to move to a safe distance and find cover.
tutorial.morphanal.dialog:
This is the screen where you can plan and perform the rite of reforging pacts. Here, by using various essences, we can obtain not only more powerful pacts but also ones that cannot be taken from the barons in the bramfaturas.

Essences have a complex interaction structure, but remember two basic rules:
Gavvakh feeds Eon, Eon feeds Shavva, Shavva feeds Agga, Agga feeds Siaira, Siaira feeds Gavvakh;
Eon calms Siaira, Siaira calms Shavva, Shavva calms Gavvakh, Gavvakh calms Agga, Agga calms Eon.

Essences have two characteristics: power and stability. The higher the power of the rite, the greater the chance of obtaining a powerful pact. The higher the stability, the lower the chance that the rite will fail and yield a weakened version of the pact instead. Low stability, however, can lead to unpredictable results.

Experiment and try different combinations of essences, and perhaps you'll uncover the secrets of the bramfaturas.
tutorial.no_ammo_in_weapon.dialog: Firearms use ammo, and energy weapons need charges. Keep in mind that reloading takes time. Avoid doing this in the midst of battle and try to find cover.
tutorial.peaceful_station.dialog:
We conduct illegal activities and are considered public enemies. That means that trade transactions between factions and the dignitas market are not available to us. But given our influence on the Solar System, corporations are ready to barter with us.

Different stations require different goods. As soon as we bring them and unload them into the station warehouse, the current holders of the station owners will be happy to exchange with us. The conditions are extortionate, but it's worth it.

Simply unload the goods to the first tab of the warehouse and sell them. And if our reputation with the faction is good, we can choose what we want to take in the second tab.
tutorial.pickup_dataidsk.dialog: Valuable items such as production chips and mercenary mind chips justify the costs of using the shuttle. If you find something like this on a mission, we can evacuate you as part of the standard procedure using the elevator or shuttle.
tutorial.pickup_pact.dialog:
You obtained a Pact. They grant operatives powerful abilities, but also demand a price. Before using a Pact's power, it must be charged. This can be done simply by increasing the Quasimorphosis meter. You can even eat meat to speed it up. Furthermore, each use of the Pact's power will either afflict the operative with a new bane, or strengthen an existing one.

Keep in mind that even the operative's death won't save them from a bound Pact and accumulated banes. Nevertheless, there are special items that allow us to mitigate the consequences of using its power, or even sever an active Pact and instantly remove all curses.
tutorial.receive_infection.dialog: Some wounds can become infected. To prevent this, use sorbent or antibiotics.
tutorial.receive_wound.dialog: Injuries are common in combat situations. The first priority is to treat the wound. You can use bandages, splints, or even ordinary rags for that. To obtain a rag, tear up any unnecessary clothing. Autodocs and surgical kits allow you to immediately heal any wound.
tutorial.starmap_with_tradeshuttle.dialo:
The barter module allows you to load a trade shuttle and send it to any location in the Solar System. Through it, we can sell even those items that stations do not usually buy, albeit at a reduced price.

Simply load the items into the shuttle and select the planet or moon to send it to. Keep an eye on the profit parameter in the corner. It takes into account item prices at stations and shows the profitability of the potential deal. Once everything is ready, click "Launch Shuttle". In a few days, it will return with the items obtained from the barter.
tutorial.toxic_paddle.dialog: Careful! There are acid puddles next to you. They are difficult to notice but they are extremely dangerous. Avoid them or let them dry.
tutorial.trainingcenter.dialog: This is a list of operators undergoing training to level up their class perks. The available maximum level for training depends on the unlocked module upgrades.
tutorial.weaponstation.dialog: This is a list of weapon modification projects. Here you can select a weapon that you have unlocked the chip for and improve its characteristics. Keep in mind that the price of modification grows exponentially, and the number of projects is limited.
tutorial.zero_starvation.dialog: Your body constantly requires calories for normal functioning. You instant clones burn a load of energy. When satiety drops to zero, the atrophy process begins, which continually reduces your health. Just eat something. Keep in mind that cannibalism is not encouraged, but not prohibited either, so if you have melee weapons, you can resort to it.
